verses.t: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
verses.pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment
verses.yusufAli: O thou folded in garments
verses.rodwell: O THOU ENFOLDED in thy mantle
verses.sale: O thou wrapped up

verses.t: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little
verses.pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little
verses.yusufAli: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night
verses.rodwell: Stand up all night, except a small portion of it, for prayer
verses.sale: arise to prayer, and continue therein during the night

verses.t: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
verses.pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
verses.yusufAli: Half of it,- or a little less
verses.rodwell: Half; or curtail the half a little
verses.sale: except a small part; that is to say, during one half thereof: Or do thou lessen the same a little

verses.t: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation
verses.pickthall: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure
verses.yusufAli: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones
verses.rodwell: Or add to it: And with measured tone intone the Koran
verses.sale: or add thereto. And repeat the Koran with a distinct and sonorous voice

verses.t: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word
verses.pickthall: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight
verses.yusufAli: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message
verses.rodwell: For we shall devolve on thee weighty words
verses.sale: For We will lay on thee a weighty word

verses.t: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words
verses.pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain
verses.yusufAli: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise)
verses.rodwell: Verily, at the oncoming of night are devout impressions strongest, and words are most collected
verses.sale: Verily the rising by night is more efficacious for stedfast continuance in devotion, and more conducive to decent pronunciation

verses.t: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation
verses.pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business
verses.yusufAli: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties
verses.rodwell: But in the day time thou hast continual employ
verses.sale: For in the day-time thou hast long employment

verses.t: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion
verses.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion
verses.yusufAli: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly
verses.rodwell: And commemorate the name of thy Lord, and devote thyself to Him with entire devotion
verses.sale: And commemorate the name of thy Lord: And separate thy self unto Him, renouncing worldly vanities

verses.t: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs
verses.pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender
verses.yusufAli: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs
verses.rodwell: Lord of the East and of the West! No God is there but He! Take Him for thy protector
verses.sale: He is the Lord of the east, and of the west; there is no God but He. Wherefore take Him for thy patron

verses.t: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance
verses.pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking
verses.yusufAli: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity)
verses.rodwell: And endure what they say with patience, and depart from them with a decorous departure
verses.sale: And patiently suffer the contumelies which the infidels utter against thee; and depart from them with a decent departure

verses.t: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little
verses.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile
verses.yusufAli: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while
verses.rodwell: And let Me alone with the gainsayers, rich in the pleasures of this life; and bear thou with them yet a little while
verses.sale: And let Me alone with those who charge the Koran with falsehood, who enjoy the blessings of this life; and bear with them for a while

verses.t: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
verses.pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire
verses.yusufAli: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them)
verses.rodwell: For with Us are strong fetters, and a flaming fire
verses.sale: Verily with Us are heavy fetters, and a burning fire

verses.t: And food that chokes and a painful punishment
verses.pickthall: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
verses.yusufAli: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous
verses.rodwell: And food that choketh, and a sore torment
verses.sale: and food ready to choke him who swalloweth it, and painful torment

verses.t: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down
verses.pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand
verses.yusufAli: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down
verses.rodwell: The day cometh when the earth and the mountains shall be shaken; and the mountains shall become a loose sand heap
verses.sale: On a certain day the earth shall be shaken, and the mountains also, and the mountains shall become a heap of sand poured forth

verses.t: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger
verses.yusufAli: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh
verses.rodwell: Verily, we have sent you an Apostle to witness against you, even as we sent an Apostle to Pharaoh
verses.sale: Verily We have sent unto you an apostle, to bear witness against you; as We sent an apostle unto Pharaoh

verses.t: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure
verses.pickthall: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip
verses.yusufAli: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment
verses.rodwell: But Pharaoh rebelled against the Apostle, and we therefore laid hold on him with a severe chastisement
verses.sale: But Pharaoh was disobedient unto the apostle; wherefore We chastised him with a heavy chastisement

verses.t: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired
verses.pickthall: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey
verses.yusufAli: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed
verses.rodwell: And how, if ye believe not, will you screen yourselves from the day that shall turn children greyheaded
verses.sale: How, therefore, will ye escape, if ye believe not, the day which shall make children become greyheaded through terror

verses.t: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled
verses.pickthall: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled
verses.yusufAli: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished
verses.rodwell: The very heaven shall be reft asunder by it: this threat shall be carried into effect
verses.sale: The heaven shall be rent in sunder thereby: The promise thereof shall surely be performed

verses.t: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way
verses.pickthall: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord
verses.yusufAli: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord
verses.rodwell: Lo! this is a warning. Let him then who will, take the way to his Lord
verses.sale: Verily this is an admonition; and whoever is willing to be admonished, will take the way unto his Lord

verses.t: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful
verses.yusufAli: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful
verses.rodwell: Of a truth, thy Lord knoweth that thou prayest almost two-thirds, or half, or a third of the night, as do a part of thy followers. But God measureth the night and the day: He knoweth that ye cannot count its hours aright, and therefore, turneth to you mercifully. Recite then so much of the Koran as may be easy to you. He knoweth that there will be some among you sick, while others travel through the earth in quest of the bounties of God; and others do battle in his cause. Recite therefore so much of it as may be easy. And observe the Prayers and pay the legal Alms, and lend God a liberal loan: for whatever good works ye send on before for your own behoof, ye shall find with God. This will be best and richest in the recompense. And seek the forgiveness of God: verily, God is forgiving, Merciful
verses.sale: Thy Lord knoweth that thou continuest in prayer and meditation sometimes near two third parts of the night, and sometimes one half thereof, and at other times one third part thereof: And a part of thy companions, who are with thee, do the same. But God measureth the night and the day; he knoweth that ye cannot exactly compute the same: Wherefore He turneth favourably unto you. Read, therefore, so much of the Koran as may be easy unto you. He knoweth that there will be some infirm among you; and others travel through the earth, that they may obtain a competency of the bounty of God; and others fight in the defence of God's faith. Read, therefore, so much of the same as may be easy. And observe the stated times of prayer, and pay the legal alms; and lend unto God an acceptable loan; for whatever good ye send before for your souls, ye shall find the same with God. This will be better, and will merit a greater reward. And ask God forgiveness; for God is ready to forgive, and merciful
